summary: Mechanical checks and the requested manual synthetic issue-spotting dry run are reported separately from source completeness and legal currentness.

compact_context_measurement.method_note: Approximation only; no model tokenizer was available.

empty_text_spine_items: Drafting Contracts How and Why Lawyers Do What They Do Second Edition.epub/titlepage.xhtml
A Manual of Style for Contract Drafting.epub/OEBPS/MSCD_FM-01.xhtml

source_coverage.extraction: Embedded text extraction was attempted for every EPUB spine item. Nonempty embedded text was obtained from 58 of 59 Stark items and 36 of 37 Adams items; empty image-based title-page files were recorded. OCR was not used. Image-based samples/figures and visual form content were not reviewed.
source_coverage.examples_exercises_forms: Inventories derived from contents and list pages; exercise/form collections were not substantively read or reproduced. Examples in reviewed sections were classified as hypotheticals, alternatives, before/after guidance, recommendations, or reported legal material as noted at locator level.

editions.stark: Second Edition verified from title page and preface.

legal_currentness.unverified: All legal discussions reported in the books, including their cited cases, statutes, and statements of doctrine; transaction-specific enforceability questions; governing-law consequences.

testing.interpretation: Manual test execution checks the library’s issue-spotting workflow. It does not establish legal accuracy or model-wide reliability.

archive_verification.method: Reopened the final ZIP, confirmed the exact member set, compared every archived file byte-for-byte with its package file, and checked all seven embedded SHA-256 entries. Repeated after recording this status.

limitations: Full substantive reading of both books is not complete.
A contents listing and extracted text do not prove the associated material was read.
Image-based samples and figures were inventoried but not visually inspected; no OCR.
No current law or jurisdiction-specific rule was verified.
Some cross-source topics remain explicitly unresolved.
Synthetic tests are manual issue-spotting exercises, not code execution or court simulations.
